title: Switch Mario Scene Storage Base
author: Foximg
description:
This is a storage base suitable for the Switch 1st generation OLED version, referencing the Super Mario NES game. In addition to perfectly storing the console, it also has 8 reserved slots for frequently played game cartridges.

Color separation has been done, and the model's assembly parts have a foolproof design, preventing incorrect installation.

For a more secure connection, it is recommended to reinforce with glue at the end.
